subject: Audit/access logs: handover exports, retention windows & erasure scope
messages:
From: Michael Porter <michael.porter@blueharbor.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Liu <anna.liu@acmecorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: audit + access log export (scope, residency, deletion)

Hi Sofia,

We're preparing for a records request and need clarity on what Redwood can provide for BlueHarbor Bank. Specifically: 

- Can you export tenant-level audit logs and access (auth / token / admin actions) for up to the last 36 months?
- What output formats do you support (CSV, NDJSON, Parquet)? Are exports filtered by region/residency?
- If we request a deletion/erase for a specific user or time range, how is that processed and how long does it take to propagate?
- What evidence / attestation do you provide that data was exported and/or deleted (checksums, manifests, signed confirmation)?

Attaching a simple template with the exact columns our compliance team expects. Also looping in Anna in Legal for the erasure/attestation questions.

Thanks — appreciate a short summary and next steps.

—Michael
Michael Porter
Head of Information Risk
BlueHarbor Bank
[Attachment: blueharbor_data_request_template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Michael Porter <michael.porter@blueharbor.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Anna Liu <anna.liu@acmecorp.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: audit + access log export (scope, residency, deletion)

Hi Michael / Anna — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary up front, then next steps below.

Summary (high level):
- Export scope: We can export tenant audit logs (admin events, role changes, policy updates) and access traces (API auth events, token exchanges, console logins).
- Supported formats: NDJSON, CSV, Parquet (you can pick per-export). We also provide a compressed tarball with a manifest and SHA256 checksums.
- Retention & residency: Default hosted retention for access traces is 90 days; admin/audit events default 365 days. For Dedicated/Enterprise customers we support archived retention windows up to 7 years (in-place or archived export) depending on contract and storage cadence. Exports can be scoped to region; we only export data that physically resides in that region unless customer has multi-region replication and requests cross-region extracts.
- Deletion/erase: Erase requests are processed as a coordinated job: we remove records from primary store, expire KV caches, and scrub replicas. Small-scope deletes (single user / <30 days) typically complete within 24–72 hours; large-range deletes (multi-months and multi-shard) can take up to 7 days to fully propagate. We provide an event log of the erase job and a signed attestation on completion.

Deliverables we can provide for each export/erase:
- Export bundle: data files (NDJSON/CSV/Parquet), manifest.json, checksums (SHA256), export job id and estimated completion time.
- Deletion attestation: job id, timeline, list of affected partitions, and a signed statement from Redwood security operations.

Attachments I’ve included: redwood-log-export-specs.pdf (format / schema), audit_access_sample.csv (sample extract), export-playbook.md (procedural playbook).

Next steps we recommend:
1) Confirm the exact time window(s) you want exported and whether you need region-limited extracts (e.g., us-east-1 only).
2) Confirm whether you need a signed attestation and the signing contact for legal.
3) We will open a JIRA task (JIRA-SUP-9876) and schedule the export window. Typical SLA for delivery depends on size but plan 24–72 hours for datasets <100GB; 3–7 days for multi-terabyte archives.

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-minute call with our security operations engineer (Rishi) and Ben from account to walk through the playbook and the DocuSign/authorization step.

—
Sofia Ivanova
Security Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

Michael — quick follow-ups from a procurement / delivery perspective: 

- Is BlueHarbor intending to make this a recurring export (monthly/quarterly) or a one-time handover? Recurring exports may require a reserved storage fee.
- Can you confirm the target delivery SLA you need for the initial handover? We quoted 24–72 hours for small sets; if you need faster delivery we can prioritize but it will be a premium option.
- We can produce a sample CSV slice for review — Sofia, can you attach a 10k-row sample with synthetic PII redaction?

Looping in Marissa for commercial/contract questions. Anna — if you want a standard DPA addendum language for erasure attestations, Ben and I can circulate a draft and include the DocuSign flow.

Thanks,
Ben

Subject: Re: Request: audit + access log export (scope, residency, deletion)

Thanks all — action plan and concrete next steps below.

Action plan (what we will do once BlueHarbor confirms scope):
1) Authorization: We will send a DocuSign (DOCUSIGN-12345) authorization form for your security/ops contact to sign (this grants temporary export rights for the tenant).
2) JIRA & kickoff: We will open JIRA-SUP-9876 and assign Rishi as the SRE lead for the job.
3) Pre-check: Lightweight schema validation against your attached template. If you can confirm columns, we’ll run a 10k-row synthetic sample and share audit_access_sample.csv for your review (no real PII).
4) Export run: We’ll run export in the requested region. Deliverables: compressed bundle, manifest, checksums, job logs, and a signed deletion attestation if an erase is requested afterwards.
5) Deletion (if requested): We schedule the erase job after you confirm receipt of the exported bundle. We’ll provide a signed attestation and the erase job id; full propagation window up to 7 days depending on size.

Typical timelines: authorization + pre-check (1–2 business days), export run for <100GB (24–72 hours), multi-terabyte (3–7 business days). Deletion attestation issued within 24 hours after erase job completes.

Attachments included for your review: redwood-log-export-specs.pdf, audit_access_sample.csv, export-playbook.md.

Proposed slots for a short technical walkthrough: Tue 2026-08-25 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 2026-08-26 14:00–14:30 PT. Let me know which works and we’ll send the invite.

Regards,
Sofia Ivanova
Security Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
